## Noble Time Elemental (CR 14)

**XP** 38,400  
 Large elemental (elemental, extraplanar, time)  
 **Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +33  

**Defense**

 **AC** 25, touch 19, flat-footed 19 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 insight, +6 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 280 (20d10+80)  
 **Fort** +10; **Ref** +19; **Will** +18  
 **Defensive Abilities** foresight; **DR** 15/—; **Immune** elemental traits, temporal magic; **SR** 25  

**Offense**

 **Speed** fly 20 ft. (perfect)  
 **Melee** 2 slams +25 (2d6+5)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** alter age 1/day (Fort DC 24), multimanifestation, temporal displacement 3/day (20 minutes, Fort DC 24)  
 **Spell-like Abilities** (CL 20th):  

  1/day—time stop (DC 21)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 20, **Con** 18, **Int** 18, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 15  
 **Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +26; **CMD** 45  
 **Feats** Combat Expertise, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (slam), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam); Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Diplomacy +22, Fly +34, Knowledge (arcana) +27, Knowledge (history) +27, Knowledge (local) +27, Knowledge (planes) +27, Perception +33, Sense Motive +27, Stealth +24, Survival +27  
**Languages** telepathy 100 ft.  
 **SQ** time jaunt (Will DC 24)  

**Special Abilities**

 **Alter Age (Su)** Once per day, a noble time elemental can age a creature simply by touching it (this requires a melee touch attack). If successful, the target must succeed on a Fortitude save or advance forward one aging step (from adulthood to middle age, from middle age to old, from old to venerable, and so on). If a character ages, he takes all the effects to his physical ability scores, but does not gain any of the bonuses to his mental ability scores. A venerable creature affected by this ability dies (from massive cell death) and cannot be restored to life by mortal magic. The save DC is Constitution-based.
